title: Export
summary: create guarded dated static HTML snapshots from exact checked document sets
content_html:
Export

Docs Viewer Export creates a browseable dated static HTML snapshot from existing generated document payloads. The output is a user-owned visual and text reference outside Docs Viewer; it is not canonical source, an import package, or a managed archive.

Workflow

Export is available in the main index panel's Index Actions menu while Manage is active. It is not present in the app-level Actions menu or sub-scope report Actions.

Opening Index Actions enters the existing checkbox-selection workflow and explicitly checks the currently displayed document. After that handoff, Export consumes only the exact non-empty checked doc_id set. It does not infer a displayed, active, default, URL, parent, or descendant document, and it has no export mode or Include descendants option. Select all is the whole-scope case.

The confirmation contains only:

Export N document(s) to:
/docs-export/<dated folder>/

The primary button is Create snapshot, Replace, or disabled Unavailable according to the previewed target. Replacement uses the danger tone and initially focuses Cancel. Cancel, success, and failure preserve the checked selection.

Input And Eligibility

A configured scope is eligible when:

  • $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR resolves the external docs-export workspace;
  • its configured generated index-tree.json is readable and non-empty; and
  • every referenced generated by-id/<doc_id>.json payload is readable and valid.

Generated-path resolution supports repo-local, public, and external-local scope providers. Canonical-source ownership and source writability are not capability gates. Non-publishable documents already present in a publish-capable Manage tree remain eligible; local collections have no publication gate.

Export reads generated hierarchy, titles, and content_html. It does not parse canonical Markdown, rebuild documents, or apply a second publishability filter.

Destination And Naming

Snapshots live under:

$DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/docs-export/

The server derives the folder from its local export date:

  • the complete checked set uses <scope> - YYYY-MM-DD;
  • every non-complete set, including one checked document with unselected peers, uses <scope> selection - YYYY-MM-DD.

Complete-set classification takes precedence for a one-document scope. Labels receive only bounded filesystem-safe normalization. There is no Save As, arbitrary destination, or background scheduling.

One equivalent label and local date names one destination. If it already exists, preview classifies it as a recognized snapshot, an unrecognized directory, or a non-directory collision. Recognized and unrecognized directories may be replaced only after explicit confirmation; a non-directory target is blocked.

Preview And Apply

The management-only endpoints are:

POST /docs/export/static-html/preview
POST /docs/export/static-html/apply

Preview accepts only the active scope and exact checked doc_ids. It returns docs_static_html_snapshot_preview_v1 with the tree-ordered ids, selection kind, deterministic default, local date, display-safe destination label, target state, existing recognized provenance when present, and plan/target revisions. It writes nothing and exposes no absolute workspace path.

Apply is assembled from that validated preview and carries:

{
  "scope": "studio",
  "doc_ids": ["doc-a", "doc-b"],
  "export_date": "2026-07-31",
  "plan_revision": "<sha256>",
  "target_revision": "<sha256>",
  "confirm": true,
  "replace_existing": false
}

The service recomputes the complete plan and destination state. A changed source plan or target requires a fresh preview. It renders and validates the complete output in a sibling staging directory before installing it. Replacement moves the confirmed existing directory aside, verifies that moved content, installs staging, and restores the original if the final switch fails.

There is no export delete route or capability. Snapshot folders are user-owned after creation; Docs Viewer does not list, rename, prune, retain, or remove them.

Artifact Contract

Each snapshot contains exactly:

<dated folder>/
  index.html
  styles.css
  snapshot.json
  docs/
    <selected doc_id>.html

index.html preserves the selected hierarchy. A selected child whose parent is absent becomes a root. The configured default document is retained when selected; otherwise the first selected document in generated tree order becomes the default.

Each document page inserts its existing generated content_html without adding another heading. Same-scope Docs Viewer links become local only when their target is included. Links to unselected same-scope documents, other scopes, and external locations retain their original targets. Fragments are preserved.

The snapshot copies no media, downloads, interactive dependencies, remote assets, or rendered Mermaid SVGs. Existing references remain references. Inline Mermaid remains readable source in its generated code block.

snapshot.json uses docs_static_html_snapshot_v1 and records the source scope, exact ordered ids, selection kind, document count, default id, local export date, generation time, and plan revision. Folder names are presentation labels; provenance owns snapshot identity for guarded replacement.

Ownership

Backend planning, rendering, provenance, target inspection, and staged apply:

docs-viewer/services/docs_static_html_export.py

Routes and capability projection:

docs-viewer/services/docs_management_routes.py
docs-viewer/services/docs_management_service.py
docs-viewer/services/docs_management_capabilities_service.py

Main-index action, exact checked-set dispatch, client, and confirmation workflow:

docs-viewer/runtime/js/management/docs-viewer-action-definitions.js
docs-viewer/runtime/js/management/docs-viewer-management-control-renderers.js
docs-viewer/runtime/js/management/docs-viewer-management-index-controller.js
docs-viewer/runtime/js/management/docs-viewer-management-client.js
docs-viewer/runtime/js/management/docs-viewer-static-html-export-workflow.js

Verification

Focused coverage lives in:

docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_static_html_export.py
docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_management_capabilities.py
docs-viewer/tests/python/test_docs_management_routes.py
docs-viewer/tests/smoke/docs_viewer_index_selection_modules.py
docs-viewer/tests/smoke/docs_viewer_service_manage.py

The focused suites cover exact single, partial, and complete membership; hierarchy and link projection; public and external-local providers; browser-safe capability and preview payloads; absent, recognized, unrecognized, non-directory, symlink, stale, render, staging, and final-switch paths; the real confirmation modal; exact preview/apply request bodies; and the absence of app-level and delete compatibility paths.
